text: Normal ABG and PFT results make primary lung disease less likely as the cause of his symptoms. I need to evaluate for cardiac or renal causes of his edema and systemic illness. REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram REQUEST TEST: Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel

text: RESULTS: Echocardiogram: Normal left ventricular systolic function, no significant valvular disease. Comprehensive Metabolic Panel: Serum Urea nitrogen 23 mg/dL, Glucose 77 mg/dL, Creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, Albumin 1.8 mg/dL, Total cholesterol 475 mg/dL

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: The massive proteinuria and fatty casts confirm nephrotic syndrome, likely secondary to underlying malignancy given the weight loss and smoking history. DIAGNOSIS READY: Nephrotic Syndrome secondary to Lung Cancer
